candidate_program.name: residual_completion_proxy
candidate_program.rationale: Scores a feasible greedy completion after including the root, normalized by total active reward, with a small local reward-share bonus. This reaches the global compatible residual; repeated greedy computation may dominate full-solve CPU.
candidate_program.rule: (weight + residual_packing) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight) + 0.05 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
